libraries.description: Direct loops written in C# without any query library.
A low-allocation re-implementation of LINQ-to-Objects that shadows the System.Linq operators and returns struct enumerables. Last released in 2019.
A value-enumerable LINQ implementation with span sources and low-allocation pipelines. The compared version is a prerelease.
A struct-based LINQ implementation with optional struct predicates that avoid delegate indirection. Last released in 2022.
The LINQ-to-Objects implementation included with .NET, exposing the Enumerable operators over IEnumerable sequences.
A zero-allocation LINQ implementation built on struct enumerators, with span and SIMD support and a complete operator surface.
